descricao_original: A bronchial vein is seen in the submucosa of a smaller bronchus. Like other systemic veins, bronchial veins carry deoxygenated blood. The majority of bronchial blood drains into pulmonary veins; the remainder enters the systemic venous system. 200x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide in the University of Colorado collection.
